title: Cárdenas in Mexico and Vargas in Brazil
goal: Compare two presidents, Lázaro Cárdenas in Mexico and Getúlio Vargas in Brazil, using cuyo to link a leader to his government and laws.
grammar: Possessive relative: cuyo, cuya, cuyos, cuyas

items: I can say what Cárdenas did for the peasants and the workers.
I can explain how Vargas ruled Brazil.
I can compare Cárdenas and Vargas.
I can name the dates of their time in power.
I can use cuyo to say whose government, laws or constitution I mean.
